subject: Integration workshop: runtime limits, KV-caching & rollout timeline
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@opsgenex.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-dev@opsgenex.com
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: request for integration workshop

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the discovery session yesterday — that was really helpful to surface performance expectations and our data residency constraints. Our engineering manager (cc'd) would like to follow up with a focused integration workshop to walk through runtime limits, KV-caching behavior, and a target rollout timeline.

Top goals for the session:
- Validate connectivity and network egress requirements for VPC deployment
- Walk through KV cache warmup and prefix-caching implications for cold-start latency
- Agree on an initial SLO and a short rollout plan (canary -> regional)

Who should attend from your side? We need someone who can talk implementation details (batching/IPC) and someone who can answer provisioning/ops questions.

Availability for our team: Thu 9/10 10:00–12:00 PT or Fri 9/11 14:00–16:00 PT. We prefer the first slot if it works for you.

Also looping in our procurement partner next week for contract timing, but this meeting is purely technical for now.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Rao
Head of Platform Engineering | OpsGenex
attachments: OpsGenex_Integration_Scope.pdf (see section 2 for sequence diagram)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@opsgenex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: request for integration workshop

PRiya — thanks for the clear goals and the scope doc. Marissa (solutions) and Rohan (infra) are cc'd and will join.

We can cover the runtime internals and provide concrete examples for KV cache behavior and batching. Proposed slots from our side:
- Thu 9/10 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 9/10 11:30–13:00 PT
- Fri 9/11 15:00–16:30 PT

If you prefer the earlier 10:00–12:00 PT window, we can shift the agenda slightly (first 30m architecture walkthrough, then a 60m implementation Q&A / lab-style runthrough).

Prep asks from opsgenex:
- A one-line description of your VPC / peering model and whether egress NAT is controlled by OpsGenex or the cloud provider
- Any max sequence-length / latency SLOs you are targeting for the first 90 days

I'll attach a short pre-read (redwood_pre-meeting-notes.docx) and an MVP checklist Rohan maintains.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_pre-meeting-notes.docx, MVP_Integration_Checklist.xlsx
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@opsgenex.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-dev@opsgenex.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: request for integration workshop

Vivek — thanks. 11:30–13:00 PT on Thu 9/10 works best for our team (gives us time to reconcile calendars). We'll join with two engineers: Siddharth (platform) and Elena (SRE). Also, procurement would prefer to attend the tail end of the call for a quick timeline check — is that OK if they join for the final 10 minutes?

Quick answers to your prep asks:
- VPC/peering: We run in our AWS org with centralized NAT. Egress IPs are controlled by OpsGenex (we can share the CIDR list ahead of time).
- Initial SLO target: p95 token latency < 300ms for 8k seq (best-effort for rollout).

I'll upload a short network diagram and the provisioning CSV by EOD.

—Priya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@opsgenex.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 07:20:00 -0700
Subject: Calendar invite + pre-reads for integration workshop (Thu 9/10 11:30 PT)

Hi all — calendar invite created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234 (Thu 9/10, 11:30–13:00 PT). Please accept when you have a moment.

Agenda (90m):
1) 11:30–11:45 — Quick context & rollout constraints (Priya)
2) 11:45–12:15 — Runtime internals: batching, KV-cache, quantization impacts (Rohan)
3) 12:15–12:45 — Network, VPC peering, egress, and firewall rules (Marissa + OpsGenex)
4) 12:45–13:00 — Rollout plan + procurement checkpoint (Vivek + procurement)

Pre-reads attached: OpsGenex_Integration_Scope.pdf (from Priya), redwood_pre-meeting-notes.docx, MVP_Integration_Checklist.xlsx, opsgenex_provisioning_requirements.csv

Also attached a lightweight lab recipe for a short demo we can run during the call if there's appetite (small container + sample traffic).

See you tomorrow — Marissa
